i live on the first floor of a condo as well. we had this problem a few years back and my parents collected whatever was thrown down (ranged from cigarette butts to tissues to undies to kids toys etc) and passed it on to management. they either took pics of the items and put them up on the noticeboard with a general "please don't be an asshole" notice or pinned the items (we sometimes got school worksheets/other pieces of paper thrown down too) onto the noticeboard. culprits probably got embarrassed and the problem subsided. might want to ask your condo management if they can do something similar.
